landingPage.headline: Meet someone worth meeting
landingPage.subheadline: Juno introduces you to one real person at a time — never a list, never both sides at once, and only once you both say yes.

features.title: One introduction at a time
features.body: No swiping, no browsing profiles. Juno finds one person who's actually a fit and introduces just them.

features.title: Nothing shared without consent
features.body: Names, photos, and contact details stay private until both sides say yes.

features.title: A real conversation, not a form
features.body: Tell Juno about yourself in chat. It asks the right questions and remembers what matters.
